pages.title: LearningApp | Learn with a clear path
pages.description: Discover LearningApp's goal-oriented learning tools, practical study activities and progress views.
pages.heading: Learn with a clear path
pages.summary: Find relevant learning material, practice what matters, and use evidence to decide what to study next.

sections.heading: Start with the goal
paragraphs: LearningApp organizes learning around goals and accessible material. Explore a target or topic in the app's Library rather than searching through disconnected links.

sections.heading: Study and check your understanding
paragraphs: The app includes Learn, Library and Progress areas. Availability and verification status vary by capability and target. Features that are still being evaluated should be treated as experimental.

sections.heading: Keep the learning experience focused
paragraphs: LearningApp's plan separates free study experiences from optional fundraising and commercial content. Public guides are intended to help people choose their next learning step without interrupting study sessions.

pages.title: How LearningApp works | Learn, Library and Progress
pages.description: Understand LearningApp's three main areas and what Fast experimental learning prioritization means.
pages.heading: How LearningApp works
pages.summary: LearningApp separates discovering content, doing activities and reviewing progress.

sections.heading: Library: find a direction
paragraphs: Browse goals, courses, subjects and study resources. LearningApp's long-term roadmap includes evaluating external content and suggesting ways to fill learning gaps; not every proposed capability is available today.

sections.heading: Learn: choose an approach
paragraphs: Use the regular learning flow to follow planned activities. For supported exam targets, Fast prioritization is available, but its broader learning-outcome effectiveness is still experimental.

sections.heading: Progress: inspect what happened
paragraphs: Use available progress and review views to check activity history. A practice result is not the same as an official exam score or a guaranteed outcome.

pages.title: Learning resource review standards | LearningApp
pages.description: Learn how LearningApp intends to evaluate official sources, dated requirements and educational material.
pages.heading: How we evaluate learning resources
pages.summary: Trustworthy guidance needs attributable sources, explicit uncertainty and clear publication controls.

sections.heading: Evidence and provenance
paragraphs: A source should identify what it establishes, when it was checked and what it does not establish. Official exam, licensing and professional requirements should be checked with the issuing body.

sections.heading: Separate verified results from exploration
paragraphs: Experimental activity design and unverified assessment claims must be disclosed. A practice estimate is not a promise of exam success or verified mastery.

sections.heading: Respect drafts and protected content
paragraphs: Unreviewed materials, learner records and protected answer banks are not eligible for the public-site export. Static public content must undergo an explicit editorial approval step before publication.

pages.title: About LearningApp | Independent learning platform
pages.description: What LearningApp is working to improve in discovering, practicing and checking learning.
pages.heading: About LearningApp
pages.summary: LearningApp is building a practical layer between learning goals, existing content and evidence of understanding.

sections.heading: Use what already exists
paragraphs: The platform's direction emphasizes discovering useful external learning resources and filling gaps where practice, diagnosis or structure are missing. This describes the roadmap, not a claim that every integration is released.

sections.heading: Protect the learner experience
paragraphs: Core study, assessment and progress flows should not be interrupted by advertising. Voluntary support and partnerships are separate from the quality or ranking of educational resources.

sections.heading: Independent and evolving
paragraphs: LearningApp is not an exam issuer and does not grant professional licenses or college credit. Features may be marked experimental while their readiness and effectiveness are evaluated.
